clips.title: The story
paras: A warrior in the northern Barrens faces Thun'grim Firegaze's test. The near-blind smith sends seasoned Horde warriors across distant lands for rare ingredients and smelting agents. Fulfilling his scroll begins the forging of a full set of brutal battle gear.

In the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze listens for news of war. The veteran orc smith's eyesight is failing, but his skill at the forge remains unmatched. Rumors reach him of a warrior whose strength and valor exceed those of ordinary soldiers. Thun'grim sets out to craft mail that can withstand the fiercest battles across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

Thun'grim's armor calls for more than common ore. By firelight, his failing eyes guide him as he writes a precise scroll for the core chestpiece. Its ingredients include refined iron, smoky iron ingots carried by burrowing kobolds, powdered azurite worked by miners across the sea, and a volatile vial of phlogiston. Only a warrior ready to face trials across distant lands can bring the required materials together.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have heard tales of your strength and valor, and wish to make for you a suit of armor, a companion to aid you as tales of your great deeds grow.
But the fashioning of this armor will be a quest unto itself, friend. I will need your help, and the help of other smiths of the Horde.

Here, take this scroll. I spent many nights, struggling with near-blind eyes, writing that which I need for the armor. Bring me the items on this scroll and I will create for you the first piece of the suit.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the items on my scroll, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought all that I asked. Now, I will do my part...
